parsed.name: Kvaser CAN总线接口适配器
parsed.description: 这是一种用于将计算机连接到CAN总线网络的硬件接口设备，可用于发送和接收CAN报文、监测总线通信，以及在实验室中对基于CAN的控制器、仪器或嵌入式设备进行联调、测试与诊断。
parsed.description_en: This is a hardware interface device that connects a computer to a CAN bus network. It is used to transmit and receive CAN messages, monitor bus traffic, and support laboratory integration, testing, and diagnostics of CAN-based controllers, instruments, and embedded systems.

actions.description: 清空设备的发送缓冲区。
通过CAN总线发送一条报文。
actions.description_en: Send a message on the CAN bus.

actions.description: 开启或关闭设备指示灯闪烁，用于物理定位设备。
actions.description_en: Turn the device LED flashing on or off for physical identification.

actions.description: 安全关闭CAN接口，并等待排队发送的数据处理完成。
actions.description_en: Safely shut down the CAN interface and wait for queued transmissions to complete.
